summary.text: In Dominaria, portions of Rath begin appearing through the Rathi Overlay and bring Phyrexian reinforcements while Urza and Dominaria's armies lose ground, and Urza takes the Weatherlight and metathran to Urborg.

Urza's nine planeswalkers attack Phyrexia with soul bombs, but Tevesh Szat betrays them, and in Phyrexia Urza is grasped by its beauty, prostrates himself before Yawgmoth and destroys the master soul bomb.
Meanwhile Darigaaz resurrects the other Primevals, and Karn talks sense into him so that he plunges into an active volcano to stop their complete power.
